flagship_directive: Construct an explicit growing sequence of bounded-size saturation experiments and prove that correlated saturation retains a nonvanishing minimax-risk advantage over optimized common-probability independent saturation.
critique: The note proves endpoint completeness, an exact finite orbit minimax formulation, conditional-uniformity reduction, a rational weak-optimization compiler, and a certified correlated-design separation. The substantive separation is confined to a hand-certified two-cluster instance, has a numerically small gap, and persists only over the stated one-dimensional contrast neighborhood. The independence result is an exact saddle-feasibility characterization rather than a structural or readily interpretable classification, while the polynomial-time claim is measured in an orbit program whose fixed-parameter constants are enormous. The framing accurately discloses these limits and does not claim an exact optimizer, an elementary equality classification, or an asymptotic separation that the theorems leave open.
